pricing_basis: Current itch low-price commercial lane supports small paid games.
Marketplace fixed payment fees make $2.99 more efficient than $0.99-$1.99.
Final price remains HUMAN_REVIEW/HUMAN_ACTION before release.

notes: Game concept, product direction and approval are human-directed.
Code and production assets may use AI assistance/generation and must be registered truthfully.
Commercial release requires original or commercially licensed characters, graphics, audio and fonts.
No third-party character IP is authorized.
Browser HTML5 path is a discovery surface.
Paid/download ownership path must be explicitly selected and verified before release.
Final policy/fee check must be refreshed within the factory release window.
Build-story video is a derivative marketing asset, not required for game RC.
Originality and synthetic-content disclosures are evaluated under the YouTube adapter.
Potential Critter coloring/activity book is a separate governed derivative and cannot inherit the game release stamp.
